name: careeros-application-assistant
description: Chrome extension for importing jobs, tracking applications, and autofilling forms

scripts.build: tsc && vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.copyFileSync('dist-content/content.js','dist/content.js');fs.rmSync('dist-content',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.copyFileSync('manifest.json','dist/manifest.json')"
